found_values.value: The TPS55285 takes current back into its output and passes it to its input in FPWM only: 'The high-side N-MOSFET is not turned off even if the current through the MOSFET is zero. Thus, the inductor current changes its direction after it runs to zero. The power flow is from output side to input side' (6.4.1). In PFM, the default (MODE register 06h bit 1 = 0), it turns the switches off at zero current 'to prevent the reverse current from output to input' (6.4.2), so a returned current raises the rail. No reverse or negative current limit is stated in the data sheet. Input OVP, 22.0 to 23.0 V rising, stops switching when the input cannot sink the returned current (6.3.14). Output OVP at 110.5 to 120 % of the target (9.28 to 10.08 V at 8.4 V; 6.08 to 6.6 V at 5.5 V) lies above both ceilings. The energy a servo returns is not stated on the servo pages read (Savox SH-0255MG+, SB-2290SG): not known. With V316 an ideal diode sits between each converter and its rail, so no back-fed current reaches the converter and PFM stays its mode

found_values.value: Found for the design the owner sets: LTC4352CMS#TRPBF with CSD17573Q5B between each TPS55285 output and its rail; OPA376AIDBVR from the 5 V rail compares the rail (332 kOhm / 100 kOhm) with the converter's output (an equal divider returned to 30.4 mV from REF3112AIDBZR), offset 0.1008 V; CSD17578Q3A switches the load resistor. MOSFET drop and loss: the LTC4352 regulates the drop to 25 mV typ, 10 to 40 mV, while I x RDS(on) is lower (9.2 mV at 6.35 A, 1.45 mOhm max at VGS 4.5 V): 0.16 W typ, 0.25 W max at 6.35 A, 0.09 W typ at 3.72 A. Feedback: internal, at the TPS55285's VOUT pin, before the MOSFET; the rail sits 10 to 40 mV below; the cable droop compensation stays off. Turn-off signal and time: the LTC4352 pulls its gate down within 0.5 us max (0.2 us typ, 10 nF, VFWD -0.2 V) once the rail rises above the converter's output; its STATUS open drain, low while the MOSFET is on, releases and lets the op-amp drive the clamp switch. Margin to the ceiling's lowest trip edge: HV -0.128 V with the converter at 8.53 V, +0.032 V at 8.40 V, +0.190 V at 8.27 V (lowest trip 8.534 V); the threshold stays 38 mV under 8.70 V. LV +0.028 to +0.248 V (lowest trip 5.740 V). Energy: not known; peak current threshold / load resistor, 6.37 A at 8.66 V with 1.36 Ohm, 6.36 A at 15.38 V with 2.42 Ohm (stage 2)
